title: Ad Studio
description: Competitor ad research and Meta ad drafts built on this project's data. Everything goes to Meta as PAUSED.

pages.title: Tracked pages
pages.hint: Facebook pages of competitors and similar brands. Ask Claude to find page IDs and pull their ads (start_ad_studio).

archive.empty: No ads yet. In Claude, say: "pull competitor ads for this project".

report.empty: The report fills in as ads are saved and tagged.

drafts.empty: No ad drafts yet. Ask Claude to write ads (start_ad_studio) or create one here.

editor.name: Name
editor.landingHint: Must be a page on the site; it is checked and gets UTM tags (utm_medium=paid_social).

send.title: Send to Meta as PAUSED
send.body: MericSEO creates the campaign, ad set and ad in your ad account with status PAUSED. Nothing runs or spends until you turn it on in Ads Manager.
send.campaignHint: Leave empty to create a new paused traffic campaign.
send.budget: Daily budget for the ad set (account currency, optional)
send.countriesHint: ISO codes separated by commas, e.g. US or TR.
